enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn again. Stretch legs. Adjust blanket. Remain asleep.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Take out spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Close drawer. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Adjust shirt. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check schedule. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to nurse station. Use computer to update records. Answer phone. Speak to doctor. Walk to another patient room. Assist patient with mobility.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out pan from cupboard and place on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil to pan. Add vegetables to pan. Add meat to pan. Stir ingredients. Add spices. Stir again. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Place plate on table. Sit at table. Eat dinner and drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate and walk to sink. Rinse plate and place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Turn on living room light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Type password. Open browser. Browse internet. Check email. Reply to email. Open document. Type document. Save document. Close document. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down laptop. Close laptop. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Open drawer. Take out pajamas. Close drawer. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Walk back to bedroom. Turn down bed covers. Set alarm on phone. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off bedroom light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn again. Stretch legs. Adjust blanket. Remain asleep.
